questions.question: Which of the following statements is true about the interference of ultrasonic waves?

answers.a: Interference only occurs in a medium with high density.
answers.b: Interference only occurs at a specific frequency.
answers.c: Interference occurs regardless of the frequency.
answers.d: Interference occurs only when the ultrasonic waves are in-phase.

questions.question: What is the purpose of knobs marked 'Adj' and 'Gain'

answers.a: The needle on the Ammeter is adjusted by 'Adj' and the sensitivity of the instrument for greater deflection is set by 'Gain'.
answers.b: To increase or decrease the frequency of ultrasonic waves generated.
answers.d: The needle on the Ammeter is adjusted by ‘Gain’ and the sensitivity of the instrument for greater deflection is set by 'Adj'.

questions.question: What is the purpose of the water column in an ultrasonic interferometer?

answers.c: To alter the frequency of ultrasonic waves

questions.question: In an ultrasonic interferometer experiment, if the water level is adjusted to produce maximum interference, what does it indicate about the path difference of the ultrasonic waves?

answers.b: The path difference is half a wavelength.
answers.c: The path difference is a full wavelength.

questions.question: What is the advantage of using an ultrasonic interferometer over other methods for measuring the speed of sound?

answers.a: It is more accurate and consistent
answers.d: It is easier to set up.
